svg.aria-label: Three panels. Top: a timeline of one run. At dispatch the live pointer is written with session_id null; the run's own stream opens and its first record already names the session; only later does the pointer's field get populated. Between the first two moments is the window in which the raw field reads null while the session to continue already exists. A reader that takes the raw field for the authority sees an unresumable run for that whole window. Middle: the three authorities resolve_session reads in order, the live pointer, the run's own stream and the promoted ledger row, with the first that names a session winning; the stopped and abandoned arms now read that resolved value, as the blocked and interrupted arms already did. Bottom: the stopped arm before and after. Before, the remedy was read from the pointer's own field, so a run whose stream still named a session was offered as discardable. Now a session in the pointer, the stream or the ledger turns the action into crew resume and the verb into resume; when nothing resolves, the next action and the verb are exactly what they were, so an absence is reported rather than assumed.
svg.text: A stopped run whose stream still names its session resumes instead of being discarded
WHY THE FIELD IS NOT THE AUTHORITY
the window: session_id reads null while the session to continue already exists
dispatch writes the pointer,
and its session field is empty
already names the session
the field is populated
A reader that takes the raw field for the authority sees an unresumable run for the whole window —
and the standing discard rule is exactly such a reader.
WHAT DECIDES THE REMEDY NOW
its own session field lags
names it from the first record
the durable record, once there is one
One resolver reads those three in order and the first that names a session wins. The stopped and abandoned arms
now read that value, as the blocked and interrupted arms already did.
THE STOPPED ARM: DISCARD OR CONTINUE
before — decided from the pointer's own field
inspect the worktree at <path> and discard when safe
null in the window, so a resumable run was offered as discardable
now — decided from the resolved session
reckon crew resume --run <id> --advice continue
verb reads resume; unresolved → advice unchanged
Measured on a synthesised run whose pointer carries no session: put the decision back on the raw field and the
resolve-from-stream case reddens; the case with no session in any authority keeps its discard advice and its verb,
so an absence is reported rather than assumed.
